blocks.explanation:
Yahan teen sines hain jin ke angles alag hain, aur in ka jama zero hai.
Find kya karna hai? \([0, 2\pi]\) ke saare solutions aur general solution.
Rule: sum-to-product formula \(\sin C + \sin D = 2\sin\frac{C+D}{2}\cos\frac{C-D}{2}\).
Kaunsi do terms jorein? Woh jin ke angles ki average (ausat) teesri term ka angle ho: \(7x\) aur \(3x\) ki average \(5x\) hai. Is se \(\sin 5x\) common factor ban jayega.
Plan: jorna, common nikalna, phir dono factors ko zero rakh kar hal karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin 3x - \sin 5x + \sin 7x = 0\).
Maloom karna: \([0, 2\pi]\) mein solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: \(\sin C + \sin D = 2\sin\frac{C+D}{2}\cos\frac{C-D}{2}\). \(\sin 7x\) aur \(\sin 3x\) ko jorne se \(\sin 5x\) banega, jo beech wali term mein bhi hai, is liye common factor mil jayega.

\(\sin 7x\) aur \(\sin 3x\) ko jorein
\[\sin 7x + \sin 3x\]
\[= 2\sin\tfrac{7x + 3x}{2}\cos\tfrac{7x - 3x}{2}\]
\[= 2\sin 5x\cos 2x\]
Kyun: \(C = 7x\), \(D = 3x\): aadha jama \(\frac{10x}{2} = 5x\) aur aadha farq \(\frac{4x}{2} = 2x\).
Dhyan dein: agar \(\sin 3x\) ko \(\sin 5x\) ke saath jorte to koi common factor na banta aur sawal ulajh jata.

Factorise karein
\[2\sin 5x\cos 2x - \sin 5x = 0\]
\[\sin 5x(2\cos 2x - 1) = 0\]
\[\sin 5x = 0 \text{ ya } \cos 2x = \tfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: dono terms mein \(\sin 5x\) hai, common nikala. Product zero hai to ya pehla factor zero, ya doosra. \(\sin 5x\) se divide nahi kiya, warna \(\sin 5x = 0\) wale saare jawab kho jate.

Jab \(\sin 5x = 0\)
\[5x = n\pi \;\Rightarrow\; x = \tfrac{n\pi}{5}\]
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein (\(n = 0, \ldots, 10\)):
\[0, \tfrac{\pi}{5}, \tfrac{2\pi}{5}, \tfrac{3\pi}{5}, \tfrac{4\pi}{5}, \pi,\]
\[\tfrac{6\pi}{5}, \tfrac{7\pi}{5}, \tfrac{8\pi}{5}, \tfrac{9\pi}{5}, 2\pi\]
Kyun: sine \(\pi\) ke har multiple par zero hota hai. 5 se divide karne ke baad har qadam \(\frac{\pi}{5}\) ka hai, aur \(n = 10\) par theek \(2\pi\) aata hai, yani 11 values.
Dhyan dein: \(0\) aur \(2\pi\) dono \([0, 2\pi]\) mein shamil hain, kyunke interval band (closed) hai.

Jab \(\cos 2x = \frac{1}{2}\)
\[2x = \tfrac{\pi}{3} + 2n\pi \text{ ya } \tfrac{5\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\]
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{6} + n\pi \text{ ya } \tfrac{5\pi}{6} + n\pi\]
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein: \(\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{7\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}\).
Kyun: cosine positive hai to angle pehle (I) ya chauthe (IV) quadrant mein, reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{3}\) (\(\cos\frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{1}{2}\)); chauthe quadrant ka angle \(2\pi - \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{5\pi}{3}\). Phir 2 se divide kiya.
Yahan bhi angle \(2x\) hai, is liye ek chakkar mein har family ke do jawab: \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) ke saath \(\frac{7\pi}{6}\), aur \(\frac{5\pi}{6}\) ke saath \(\frac{11\pi}{6}\).

Saare jawab ikatthe karein
\[\left\{\tfrac{n\pi}{5}\right\} \cup \left\{\tfrac{\pi}{6} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\tfrac{5\pi}{6} + n\pi\right\}\]
Kyun: kisi ek family ki value doosri family mein nahi aati (\(\frac{\pi}{6}\) \(\frac{\pi}{5}\) ka multiple nahi), is liye koi value do dafa nahi gini gayi. \([0, 2\pi]\) mein kul \(11 + 4 = 15\) values.

Tasdeeq: \(x = \frac{\pi}{6}\)
\[\sin\tfrac{\pi}{2} - \sin\tfrac{5\pi}{6} + \sin\tfrac{7\pi}{6}\]
\[= 1 - \tfrac{1}{2} - \tfrac{1}{2} = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\sin\frac{5\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\) (doosra quadrant, sine positive) aur \(\sin\frac{7\pi}{6} = -\frac{1}{2}\) (teesra quadrant, sine negative). Asal equation poori ho gayi.
blocks.final_answer:
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein (15 values): \(x = 0, \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{5}, \frac{2\pi}{5}, \frac{3\pi}{5}, \frac{4\pi}{5}, \frac{5\pi}{6}, \pi, \frac{7\pi}{6}, \frac{6\pi}{5}, \frac{7\pi}{5}, \frac{8\pi}{5}, \frac{9\pi}{5}, \frac{11\pi}{6}, 2\pi\)
General solution \(= \left\{\frac{n\pi}{5}\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{\pi}{6} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{5\pi}{6} + n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\)

blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Is liye aap apna jawab yahan wale jawab se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
